import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n, m, x, y, vx, vy = map(int, data)

def gcd(a, b):
    while b:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

dx = n - x if vx == 1 else x if vx == -1 else float('inf')
dy = m - y if vy == 1 else y if vy == -1 else float('inf')

dx = dx // abs(vx) if vx != 0 else float('inf')
dy = dy // abs(vy) if vy != 0 else float('inf')

gcd_val = gcd(dx, dy)

if dx < float('inf') and dx == dy and gcd_val % 2 == 0:
    print(x + vx * (dx // 2), y + vy * (dy // 2))
else:
    print(-1)
